profile.headline: Software Engineer at The Shyft Group
profile.summary: Throughout my student life, I've taken major interest in programming, however, I studied an electronics related major since I wanted my projects to be present in a physical sense. The present time is ideal for me since IoT is becoming a huge thing and I'm deeply interested in developing IoT solutions for everyday life.

positions.title: PLC Software Design
positions.description:
Designed an easy to use monitoring system for Copeland Compressors using Eliwell PLC technology.
Received training on refrigeration systems design.
